title: The Hen on the Hat
lines: Kip had a pet hen. He fed it nuts.
The hen did hop up on his hat!
"Hop up!" said Kip. The hen did hum.
"It is hot in the sun," said Mom.
"The hat can be a hut," said Dad.
"Can a hen nap on me?" said Kip.
"It can," said Dad. "The hen is not mad."
Kip sat in the sun. The hen did nap.

questions.listenFor: Up on Kip's hat. The story says it. If your child is stuck, have them find the word hat and read that line again.

questions.ask: Why did Dad say the hat was like a hut?
questions.listenFor: Because the sun was hot and the hat gave the hen shade. Listen for hot and sun - Dad is explaining, not joking.

questions.ask: Would you let a hen nap on you? Tell me why or why not.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason - it would tickle, it would be warm, or you would want to move.
